summary: Batch #9 (Weekly Meal Planner + Recipes + Auto-fill Shopping) tested end-to-end — 13/13 backend pytest cases and every listed frontend flow passed. Backend: GET /api/recipes returns 4 seeded recipes newest-first with author hydration; POST creates with trimmed title + ingredient list; empty title -> 400; unknown id -> 404; DELETE enforces 403 for non-creator non-admin and cascades meal_plans on success. GET /api/meals?week_start=<Monday> hydrates each entry with recipe {ingredient_count, title, ...} and returns the 4 seeded meals (Mon dinner Rajma Chawal, Tue breakfast Masala Dosa, Wed dinner Paneer Butter Masala, Fri dinner Veg Pulao). POST /api/meals replaces (not duplicates) on same day+slot, invalid slot/day -> 400, unknown recipe_id -> 404. DELETE /api/meals/{plan_id} removes. POST /api/meals/to-shopping is idempotent: first call added=17, second call added=0 (same list_id), no meals -> 400, list is named 'Meal Plan 🍽️' and actually contains ingredients (Kidney beans, Basmati rice, Paneer, Potato, Onion, Dosa batter etc.). Frontend: More>Recipes shows the 4 seeded recipes and detail hydrates with author + ingredients; add-recipe-btn -> create modal -> add-ingredient adds a 4th row -> save-recipe-btn lands on /recipes/{new_id}. More>Meal Planner shows current week (10-16 Aug 2026) with seeded meals filled, empty slot tap opens 'Choose a recipe' modal, pick fills the slot, slot-clear removes it, week-prev/next switches label and dates. 'meals-to-shopping' shows toast 'Added 17 items to your Meal Plan 🍽️ list 🛒' and navigates to the shopping list which lists all 17 ingredients. Regression: Shopping Lists screen still shows Grocery/Pharmacy plus the newly created 'Meal Plan 🍽️' (0/17 bought). Google Sign-In wiring visible on welcome + login screens (not automated per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~2702 lines — same recommendation as previous iterations to split into feature modules (recipes/meals in their own router). Not blocking.

In /api/meals/to-shopping, agg dedupes by lower-case ingredient name but concatenates quantities via ' + '. Works, but quantity strings like '2 cups + 3 cups' are not summed — acceptable/expected for a shopping list, worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Fresh TEST_meal_* accounts + POST /seed/demo per pytest module for backend isolation. UI tests used the pre-seeded mealdemo@fam.com account. Also created 'TEST_UI_Chai' recipe via UI and 'TEST_Aloo Paratha' via API — safe to leave (family is a demo family).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch #9 is stable. Auth: welcome -> 'I already have an account' -> Log In. On first Home render an affection overlay 'Priya sent you Hug' must be dismissed via 'Tap to close' before touching testIDs. In-app navigation is required (More tab -> Meal Planner / Recipes); the test container's 'today' is Sun 16 Aug 2026 so the current-week Monday is 10 Aug 2026 and seeded meals map to Mon(dinner)/Tue(breakfast)/Wed(dinner)/Fri(dinner). /families/me returns {family, members} (invite_code lives inside .family, but /families/invite is the clean endpoint). /families/join expects {code} not {invite_code}. Auto-fill endpoint reuses the family's 'Meal Plan 🍽️' list, so tests that call it repeatedly on the same week correctly show added=0 the second time.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Batch #9. Recipes CRUD, meal-plan slot replace/delete cascade, and idempotent auto-fill all behave as specified. Frontend and backend are correctly integrated.
